notes.title: The update with the new trainset is out!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your patience and support – we’ve just released one of the most anticipated updates! What’s new?

We’ve added one of the most requested features to the game – the legendary 81-71 trainset, bringing a completely new driving experience. Along with it comes a more realistic control mode, perfect for fans of precision and authentic procedures. Both historical trainsets, EČS and 81-71, now feature an interactive cab, allowing you to control most elements directly, including newly implemented functional compressors and a wide range of new sounds that enhance the immersive feeling of sitting in the driver’s seat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/4be78a3de4fa7685461ba90a17c3a643a32f14a3.jpg

A new addition is the stop accuracy rating, giving you feedback on your performance and helping you fine-tune your driving to perfection. If you enjoy competition, you’ll love the new global leaderboard for the most accurate drivers – compare your results with players around the world. We’ve also added achievements to reward your skill and dedication.

And last but not least – this update fixes many previously reported bugs, so the game will run smoother than ever before. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to your feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/a9187905eda7012f82ce0a5386bfd4a194bbbbd4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/0a443058213be48d58fc09a0e188503abe3ba204.jpg

Highlights:

Legendary 81-71 trainset

More realistic control mode

Interactive cab for EČS and 81-71

Functional compressors

Many new sounds

Stop accuracy rating

Global leaderboard

Achievements

Numerous bug fixes

notes.title: Big Update is Out! 🚇🆕
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/e50dd234f399ab97c95f70fceebbac891a535c0d.jpg

We have great news for all fans of our game! A new update is here, bringing lots of improvements and new content. What’s waiting for you?

🔹 New Passengers – Completely reworked models of all passengers, who can finally sit down! Your trains will now feel even more realistic and lively.

🔹 New Stations – We’re expanding the playable section to include Jiřího z Poděbrad, Flora, and Želivského stations. There’s also a new turning point beyond Želivského.

🔹 Flexible Routes – You’ll now be able to choose between longer and shorter routes, so you can tailor the game to how much time you have for driving.

🔹 New Challenges – Can you handle the Bucket Challenge?

🔹 Authentic Announcements – In collaboration with Mrs. Lavičková herself, we’ve prepared brand-new announcements that will enhance the metro atmosphere even further!

🔹 New unlockable EČS improvement - insert your Timetable directly into the cabin.

🔹 Many Bug Fixes

This update is another step toward expanding and improving the game – thank you for your support, and we’re excited to hear your feedback! 🚆💨

(We are sorry, Mac OS version will be a little delayed due to techincal complications.)
